H-V complexed, negative Adjusting Sound Level In stereo mode, use the volume contro! of each channels separately (L and R). In monaural mode, use the L-volume contro! to adjust the sound level. The R-volume control is inoperative in mono mode. (4) Handle with care. Ss HOW TO CHANGE MONAURAL/STEREO Note: Mono and stereo sound cannot operate simultaneously. FOR MONO OUTPUT Turn OFF the SW3 of the Dip Switch No.3. Connect pin 10 and pin L of the 56 pin edge con- nector to the loud speaker. Use the L-volume contro! to adjust the sound level FOR STEREO OUTPUT Turn ON the SW3 of the Dip Switch No.3 Use pins 1 and 2 of the 13 pin socket for the right hand channel Use pins 3 and 4 of the same socket for the left hand channel Turn R-volume control clockwise and the right hand channel becomes louder. Turn L-volume control clockwise and the left hand channel becomes louder. Note: See diagram below. Do not use pins 10 and L on the 56 pin edge connector.
